selector.note: Each coordinate is raw phi(y_swap)-phi(y_base). phi is binary output margin for the neural model and +/-1 class output for the abstract model.

brute_force_singleton_behavior.note: Ranks singleton sites by direct calibration intervention behavior, without PLOT/UOT ranking or top-K soft handles.

ground_truth_singleton_test_behavior.note: Oracle diagnostic only: ranks every singleton site by heldout/test intervention behavior. This uses test labels and should not be treated as a calibration-time selector.
